story.fullStory:
Johnny Cash's "Personal Jesus" — original release 1990. "Personal Jesus" is a song by the English electronic band Depeche Mode.

It was released as the lead single from their seventh studio album, Violator (1990), in August 1989 by Mute Records.

The single was their first to enter the US top 40 since 1984's "People Are People" and was their first gold-certified single in the US.

American IV: The Man Comes Around is the 67th studio album by American country musician Johnny Cash, and the last to be released during his lifetime.

American IV: The Man Comes Around is the 67th studio album by American country musician Johnny Cash, and the last to be released during his lifetime.
It is the fourth entry in Cash's American series of albums, considered by some critics to be his finest work towards the end of his life.
